{{Lang|Chenpi|zh= 陈皮}} is an NPC located in {{Location|Jinzhou (Area)}}. 

As a [[Relic Merchant]], Chenpi accepts and exchanges [[Sonance Casket]]s with the player through the [[Relic Merchant#Casket Delivery|Casket Delivery]] process.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|Chenpi}}

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Chenpi}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue start}}
:'''Chenpi''': Time flies by, anything can change, yet the Sonance Caskets shall endure...
:{{DIcon|Sonance Casket Delivery}} I want to deliver Sonance Caskets.
::'''Chenpi''': Remember to stop and look around as you explore. Maybe there are ancient relics on those faraway mountains. Who knows?
::''(Opens Casket Delivery)''
:{{DIcon}} Gourmet Rumors.
::'''Chenpi''': Though I've tasted a lot of food during my journey, when it comes to cooking. I'm a bit of a... what's the word...
::'''Chenpi''': Ah, "TERRIBLE".
::'''Chenpi''': But salt is the ultimate seasoning for every dish. Add some salt, you can't go wrong.
:{{DIcon}} Chat.
::'''Chenpi''': Thanks to my kind patrons, this small relic business of mine has been thriving despite having no storefront.
::'''Chenpi''': Well, if it isn't the insightful Rover? Here to support my business with more Sonance Caskets again?
::{{DIcon}} Are Sonance Caskets valuable?
::'''Chenpi''': Value is a complex term. In the business world, money talks. But once it becomes the sole measure of worth, we must proceed with caution.
::'''Chenpi''': A mutually beneficial agreement is what I strive for.
::'''Chenpi''': One's discarded items can hold great value for another, especially in my line of work as a collector of relics.
::'''Chenpi''': Should you come across any Sonance Caskets in your travels, I'd gladly take them off your hands for a price that'll make it worth your while.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave.
{{Dialogue end}}
